"},{"id":"p39s7","text":"- Tool guidance tells the model to obtain user confirmation before purchases, publication, destructi"},{"id":"p39s8","text":"ve remote actions, and account/security changes.

- CDP"},{"id":"p43s4","text":" commands do not have complete internal deadlines or reconnect/replay behavior;
- snapshot returns c"},{"id":"p43s5","text":"omplete page text and HTML;
- credential writes and Windows ACL behavior are unchanged;
- Windows bi"},{"id":"p43s6","text":"naries are not Authenticode-signed in the first release;
